name: Homeless House Band
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Bartini Bar & Lounge (Babylon) - event calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Official name is 'The Homeless House Band' (THHB). The site has only a contact form on the home page (no separate booking page, email or phone; the phone numbers on its events page belong to the venues). No Facebook/Instagram linked; the site's 'THHBPlus YouTube Channel' page embeds videos via a script, so the channel URL could not be confirmed. The only group photo on the site is too small (458 px); the two photos used show single members playing in their rehearsal studio.
description: Long Island band from the Wantagh and Bellmore area that plays classic rock, Southern rock and R&B covers along with its own original songs, which it records at a studio in North Bellmore.

logo.alt: THHB logo: a black microphone next to the letters THHB, with 'The Homeless House Band' underneath

photos.alt: A band member in glasses and a blue shirt playing a red electric guitar in a rehearsal studio with foam-covered walls
A band member in a red T-shirt and baseball cap playing electric guitar on a stool in the rehearsal studio

evidence.note: Bartini Bar & Lounge (Babylon) lists HOMELESS HOUSE BAND on Fri Nov 20 at 8 PM and points to thehomelesshouseband.com.
Band's own events page lists Whiskey Rocks (West Babylon) on Oct 17, 2026 and The Bartini Bar (Babylon) on Nov 20, 2026; past events include Bartini's in 2019 and 2023.
Band says it records and rehearses at Hard Drive Studios in Bellmore, NY; albums 'New Moon Smile' and 'Hello Brooklyn'.
BandMix profile: Wantagh, NY band of musicians in their 60s playing classic rock plus some originals; lists R&B, classic rock, Southern rock.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: bartinibabylon.com, thehomelesshouseband.com, bandmix.com.
